people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Tobiah
people.line: Ammonite official who opposed Nehemiah's rebuilding efforts

translations.web: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, “What they are building, if a fox climbed up it, he would break down their stone wall.”
translations.bsb: Then Tobiah the Ammonite, who was beside him, said, “If even a fox were to climb up on what they are building, it would break down their wall of stones!”
translations.kjv: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, Even that which they build, if a fox go up, he shall even break down their stone wall.
translations.asv: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, Even that which they are building, if a fox go up, he shall break down their stone wall.
